title: Japanese Yen flatlines ahead of Fed rate decicion
summary: The USD/JPY pair holds steady near 155.25 during the early Asian session on Wednesday. Traders prefer to wait on the sidelines ahead of the US Federal Reserve (Fed) interest rate decision later on Wednesday. On Friday, attention will shift to the Bank of Japan (BoJ) interest rate decision.

title: European space sector in the spotlight as Paris hosts International Space Summit
summary: Paris's Grand Palais will host a two-day International Space Summit this Wednesday to promote global cooperation in the sector. A number of deals and investments for European space firms are expected to be announced as part of a wider plan to strengthen Europe's position in a field dominated by the US and China. Also in this edition: the US and Canada are locked in a tit-for-tat battle over tariffs.
